_comment: List of conference data files (relative to this folder). Order does not matter — the site sorts them. Each filename should be stable across years (e.g. 'neurips.json'). Bump the year/dates/stats inside the file each cycle. 'notificationDate' (YYYY-MM-DD) is when decisions land — it drives the 'if it gets rejected, where next?' planner; set 'notificationEstimated': false once the official date is announced. 'reviewDate' (YYYY-MM-DD or null) is when reviews reach authors, ahead of the verdict — set it to null for venues with no author-response phase and it is left off the timeline.
